description.zh: 用于保证请求的幂等性。由客户端生成该参数值，保证在不同请求间唯一。大小写敏感、不超过64个ASCII 字符。
description.en: A client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. The client generates this value to make sure that the value is unique among different requests. The token is case-sensitive and cannot exceed 64 ASCII characters in length.
